summary: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the pricing of a US$1 billion zero-coupon convertible bond offering due 2031, offered under Regulation S outside the U.S. Proceeds will fund subsidiary capital contributions for debt repayment and material purchases. No special-situation elements—such as a merger, tender, spin-off, or activist campaign—are present. The filing is a routine financing disclosure by the issuer. Watch for conversion terms and potential dilution, but this is not a special situation.
